up: Retrieve chembl_id, pref_name, exact activity values (standard_value and standard_units), and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614331. Join activities with assays on assay_id and filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614331'. Restrict to exact activity values by filtering activities.standard_relation = '='. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno to get chembl_id and pref_name. Join compound_structures on activities.molregno to get canonical_smiles. Return one row per activity with columns: chembl_id, pref_name, standard_value, standard_units, canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614331' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
